digest.component_or_area: structured-output orchestration and Pydantic AI seams
propositions: RP-01 must preserve Rebar's historical behavior around deterministic repair, schema extraction, three-attempt ceiling, stop-reason fast-fail, derived budgets, fallback predicate/order, and durable usage telemetry, reconstructed from 15 historical ticket aliases and 407 existing tests

Pydantic AI 1.107.2 native Agent/output/retry/UsageLimits/FallbackModel seams require adapters to enforce Rebar's provider-aware output-mode policy, request-budget sharing, complete failed-response handling on deterministic fit, and bounded output-size retry with specific guidance

Seven Phase-4 maintainer decisions were approved: one operation-wide request budget with raise-the-limit caveat; complete failed response only on proven fit else whole omission; aggregate successful-retry usage into single operation row; re-raise only exact Rebar-owned output error from Pydantic cause chain; terminal refusal/content-filter; and trace-not-usage candidate observability

Offline probe with pydantic-ai-slim 1.107.2 executed 28 declared observations across real Agent, PromptedOutput, NativeOutput, FallbackModel, UsageLimits, and event-stream seams with mocked provider transport, confirmed complete existing test regression (290 passed), and recorded exact observable oracles for all retry, fallback, truncation, and exception scenarios

Implementation ticketization deferred to pydantic-ai lane per Phase-4 completion; research artifacts (.joe-janitor/rp01-pydantic-native-research.md, probes, and audit notes) remain in git-excluded checkout-local recovery archive under operator attestation of all nine acceptance criteria
